name: Observation
abstract: A scientific observation or measurement of a heritage object or place — environmental monitoring, condition assessment, conservation science — profiling the SOSA/SSN Observation. `hasFeatureOfInterest` ties the reading back to the heritage object or place being measured (CIDOC-CRM/CRMsci's scientific observation context); `madeBySensor` is expected to reference an OGC SensorThings API `Sensor`.
